verses.text: Ix yalanxi winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
¿B'ak'inh wal ol eyaktej he tzuntzan owaj in yaelal tik, tzeyak'an kus in k'ol yet' juntzanh he lolonel tik?
Ayexnhejoch eyalan chukal lolonel t'ayin. ¿Tom max ex k'ixwi eyalan t'ayin?
K'inalok yel ay in mul chi', ¿tom tzeyab' syail yuj?
Tzeyik' wal chaanh he b'a t'ayin yuj in yaelal tik, tzeyalanoch t'a in sat to chuk in.
Palta komonok snachajel eyuuj to ha Dios icha tik tzin utani. A' ix in ak'anem t'a yol jun yaal tik.
Skomon el waw, swalan icha tik: Swab' wal in chami, xin chi. Palta malaj mach stak'wi t'ayin. Tzin nib'ej ay mach tzin kolani, palta malaj mach sb'oan yaj t'ayin.
Ha Dios ix makan yol in b'e, yik maxtzak yal in b'eyek'i. Ichato t'a skal k'ik' k'inal tzin ek' yuj.
Ix yik'ek' in b'eyumal, ix yik'anek' sniwanil welk'ochi.
Ix in satem t'a junelnhej. Ha tas ayoch yipok in k'ool, pilan ix lajwiel icha junok te te' malaj sch'anhal yib'.
Ix sekkot yowal sk'ool t'a wib'anh, icha wal junok yajk'ool ix in yutej.
Masanil heb' soldado Dios chi' ix och hoyan t'ayin. Ix oymaj heb' t'a spatiktak in pat yik syak'an owal heb' wet'ok.
Ha Dios chi' ix ik'anel heb' wuk'tak yet' heb' wamigo t'a in tz'ey, ichaxonhej junok komon anima ix in yutejkan heb'.
Ha heb' ayto wuj in b'a yet'ok yet' heb' wamigo, ix in yaktejkan heb', ix in b'atkan satk'olal yuj heb'.
Haxo heb' kajan t'a in pat yet' masanil heb' in chekab', icha junok ch'ok animail ix in ajkan t'a heb', maxtzak in yilochlaj heb'.
Tato swawtejkot junok heb' in chekab' chi', maxtzak tak'wilaj heb' t'ayin, wach'chom tzin tewi t'a heb'.
Ayik tzin k'och t'a stz'ey ix wetb'eyum, chuklaj sjab' xob'al in ti' syab' ix, haxo heb' ayto wuj in b'a yet'ok, tzin syajel heb'.
Icha pax chi' heb' unin tzin spatikejel heb'. Ayik syilan heb' wek'i sb'uchwaj heb' t'ayin.
Ha wal heb' ek'b'al te wach' wak'an yet'ok, tzin spatikejel heb'. Ha wal heb' tzin te tzalaj yet'ok, ix meltzajoch heb' ajk'olal t'ayin.
Toxo ix takjioch in tz'umal yet' in b'ak'chil t'a in b'akil, tewelxonhej pitzan in.
Ex wamigo, ok'okab' he k'ool t'ayin, yujto ha Dios ix ak'ankot jun yaelal tik t'a wib'anh.
¿Tas yuj tzak'anexnhej wuuj, icha tzin yutej Dios? ¿Tom manh k'okb'ilokxo in eyak'an kusok?
Ayok wal mach stz'ib'ankan juntzanh in lolonel tik. Komonok tz'ak'chajkanoch t'a k'een k'een.
Komonok a yet' k'een cincel nab'a hierro tz'ak'jikanoch t'a k'een k'een yik skan t'a junelnhej.
Wojtak to a in Kolumal pitzannhej, haxo t'a slajwub' k'ual ol emul t'a sat lum tik yik tzin skolani.
Wach'chom slajwiel in tz'umal tik, palta ol wil wal och Dios yet' in niwanil tik.
Ha in wal lak'an ol wil wal och yet' in sat, manh ch'okok mach ol ilanok. Wanxo slajwik'och wip swab'i.
Ayik swab'an eyalan icha tik: ¿Tas wal skutej kak'an kus sk'ol winh, yujto munil a winh tz'ik'ankot syaelal chi' t'a yib'anh? xe chi.
Palta xiwanhek t'a k'een espada, haton yowal sk'ol Dios syak'lab'ej t'a heb' sk'ulan chukal. Ojtakejekeli to ay jun Dios tzonh ch'olb'itani, xchi winhaj Job chi'.
